chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from Utbah the cane-seller, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his ancestors (peace be upon them), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Paradise longs for the beloveds of Ali (peace be upon him), and its light intensifies for the beloveds of Ali (peace be upon him), while they are still in the world before they enter it. And Hell becomes enraged, and its roaring intensifies against the enemies of Ali (peace be upon him), while they are still in the world before they enter it.'
ai.seo_question: What happens in Paradise and Hell regarding the lovers and enemies of Imam Ali (a.s.) while they are still in this world?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal* highlights the metaphysical reality of *Wilayah* by depicting Paradise and Hellfire as sentient entities reacting to the status of Ali’s lovers and enemies even during their earthly life. It underscores the Shia doctrine that love for the Ahl al-Bayt is not merely a social bond but a cosmic determinant of one's ultimate fate, reflecting the spiritual gravity of their divine authority.
